title: 2001 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 4
statement: Some students are taking a math contest, in which each student takes one of four tests. One third of the students take one test, one fourth take another test, one fifth take the next test, and 26 students take the last test. How many students are taking the contest in total?

solutions.text: Call the total number of students \(n\). We know \(n=\frac{n}{3}+\frac{n}{4}+\frac{n}{5}+26\), so \(n=120\).
